title: Large signed sums of unit vectors: the first linearly dependent case
summary: We address a problem on large signed sums of unit vectors that arose in work of Brugger, Fiedler, González Merino and Kirschbaum and was later formulated in its present form by Ambrus and Nietert. Given $d+1$ unit vectors $u_1,\ldots,u_{d+1}$ in $\mathbb R^d$, with $d\ge2$, the problem asks for the smallest possible value of \[ \max_{\varepsilon_i=\pm1} \left\|\sum_{i=1}^{d+1}\varepsilon_i u_i\right\|. \] We prove that this value is $\sqrt{d+2}$.
